string.text: On by default. Each day, about 35 percent of eligible bandit parties in Empire, Vlandia, and Sturgia are picked once. The sliders set how much of a picked party is replaced with Mounted Pillagers and Mounted Ransackers. Off stops new placements. Parties already changed are left as they are. Parties at sea are never changed.
Percent of that clan's regular troops replaced with Mounted Pillagers and Mounted Ransackers. Default 35, which is what the mod does now. From 1 to 80. The rest of the party stays vanilla.
Off by default, as the mod is now. Land parties of this clan in Empire, Vlandia, and Sturgia can be partly replaced. Parties at sea, and parties that cannot travel on land, stay vanilla.
Land parties of this clan in Empire, Vlandia, and Sturgia can be partly replaced. Parties at sea, and parties that cannot travel on land, stay vanilla.
On by default. Shows the War Sails bandit clans below. Both start off, matching the mod now. Off leaves those parties vanilla. Does nothing when War Sails is not installed.

Off by default, as the mod is now. War Sails Sea Raiders: Sea Raider troops, looter culture, and ships. Only their land parties in Empire, Vlandia, and Sturgia can be partly replaced. Parties at sea stay vanilla.
Off by default. Corsairs have their own troops and ships. Only their land parties in Empire, Vlandia, and Sturgia can be partly replaced. Parties at sea stay vanilla.

On by default. Boss parties only. One switch covers both, because Boss is the upgrade of Chief. This percent of the replaced troops are Chief or Boss, split between them. Default 50, matching the current mix. From 1 to 80. The rest of the replaced troops are Mounted Pillagers and Mounted Ransackers.
Percent of the replaced troops on a boss party that are Horse Bandit Chief or Horse Bandit Boss. Default 50. From 1 to 80.
Upgrades to Vlandian Brigand Champion, then Banner Knight. Off restores Vlandian Champion. Reopen the encyclopedia page.
